lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、地域、絶対、物産、絶対、関連の、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case seriously and will work with the police on all matters related to this incident. We appreciate your support.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Open with quiet authority. Steady eye contact level. No rush—each phrase lands with equal weight. Composed bearing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様への、本気で、絶対、報告書、絶対、書体、絶対、統一しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been keeping our reports to the police department carefully formatted and consistent.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight lean forward—showing readiness to cooperate. Clear enunciation. Not deferential, but genuinely engaged in the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者の、本気で、絶対、めずらしい、絶対、行動パターン、絶対、警察、絶対、分析しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect's behavior pattern is unusual. We're analyzing it carefully with the police investigation.
lines.style: Factual, deliberate. Slight pause before 'unusual'—weight the observation. Steady, procedural tone. Not dramatic, just precise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、本気で、絶対、聴取、絶対、自然体、絶対、で、絶対、受けさせていただきます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We'll approach the police interview naturally and with full cooperation.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Soft breath at the start. Direct but not rigid—conversational within formality. Shows he's listening and ready.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査の、絶対、手際、絶対、磨き続けております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: The investigation continues and we're refining our approach with each step.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'continues'—conveying ongoing commitment. Even pace. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。フィッシング、本気で、絶対、詐欺被害、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご相談、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We consulted with the police about the phishing fraud matter and appreciate their guidance.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude underneath. Medium pace, slightly warmer than the previous line. Acknowledgment without overselling the thanks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察報告書を、本気で、絶対、題する、絶対、書類、絶対、慎重に、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're compiling our police report carefully, making sure all documentation is thorough and well-organized.
lines.style: Deliberate, careful. Light emphasis on 'thoroughly'—shows attention to detail. Steady breathing. Professional but not hurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様からの、本気で、絶対、未読、絶対、メール、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed there are no unread messages from the police department.
lines.style: Alert, thorough. Clipped slightly on 'confirmed'—shows diligence. Closing tone—suggests we're wrapping up the check-in. Still engaged but moving toward resolution.
